column2: A very thin insulating barrier between two superconductors (in practice a thin aluminum oxide layer between two aluminum layers). If the barrier is thin enough, the superconducting electrons (Cooper pairs) tunnel through it without losing energy. Key property for qubits: its inductance depends on the current through it (nonlinear), so the circuit's energy levels are no longer equally spaced and the 0-1 transition can be addressed on its own.

column1: What are the five DiVincenzo criteria for a useful physical implementation of a quantum computer?
column2: 1. Scalable, well-characterized qubits. 2. Reliable initialization of the qubits. 3. Long coherence times. 4. A universal set of quantum gates. 5. Qubit-specific measurement. Two additional communication criteria are: 6. Interconversion between stationary and flying qubits. 7. Faithful transmission of flying qubits between specified locations. Memory hook: Build → Initialize → Preserve → Control → Measure.
